title: Enchant Extractor
description: This project adds a book to Minecraft that helps identify spells
body:
🌟 Features

**📦 Installation ** Download the Datapack .zip file.

Place it in your world's datapacks folder.

Enter your world and run the 
```
/reload
```

Place your **“Enchant Extractor”** next to any enchanted item on the ground (except for enchanted books); this will transfer your enchantments to the book.

* A visual effect indicates when the process is complete.

Full Compatibility: Works seamlessly with armor, swords, pickaxes, and even modded items (as long as they use the standard NBT structure).

Anvil Support: Extracted enchantments are 100% compatible with standard Minecraft mechanics; you can continue to combine them using an anvil.<iframe width="280" height="155" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Y5tHDFObK7w" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


🧱 Compatibility

Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.4+
